items.independentDerivation: Let ∠ADE = x. Then ∠AED = 90° − x; using the straight line at E and ∠DEC = 90°, ∠CEB = x, so ∠ECB = 90° − x. Also ∠EDC = 45°, so ED = EC. The supplied matching ticks give AD = BC; with the right angles at A and B, RHS establishes EDA ≅ ECB in the requested order. The draft AAS argument instead establishes EDA ≅ CEB, because ∠AED corresponds to ∠ECB.
